$comment: THE source of truth for John's career. Every output (one-page PDF, ATS PDF/docx, long CV, markdown, LinkedIn blocks, search chunks 21/23/26/27/50, john-hanacek.json, media-kit boards) compiles from this file. Facts carry `evidence` (chunk ids, site pages, external links). Wording rules: did what, for whom, what came of it; numbers only where audited; no self-assessment adjectives. Nothing private lives here — the phone number and other application-only fields come from .local/private.json at compile time. Interview record: .local/mirror-interview.md (gitignored). Compiled 2026-09-09 from the 2026-09-09 interview.

designEngineer.label: Product Design Engineer (AI products)
designEngineer.summary: Product design engineer, 14 years, across AI, web, 3D and XR. Shipped Nanome 2's XR molecular design tool to pharma customers, background in AR situational-awareness HUDs for first responders, and a portfolio site whose search runs a language model in the browser. Founding design for early-stage teams through JHDesign LLC. Prototypes in code (JavaScript, Three.js, WebGL, WebGPU) and in Unity.

productDesigner.label: Product Designer (AI / agentic)
productDesigner.summary: Product designer, 14 years, with a research-led practice. Led product design for Nanome 2 on Meta Quest, the web portal and the Mara AI assistant, running ~24 alpha and beta sessions with pharma scientists and turning coded feedback into a navigation pivot that shipped. Designs agentic systems and the tools people use to run them, including a coaching product and client workshop systems.

foundingDesigner.label: Founding Designer
foundingDesigner.summary: Founding designer for early-stage teams since 2012, through JHDesign LLC since 2024. Brand, product and site delivered as working code: OpenProse's founding design went from brand to live homepage in two months (37 live approaches, 471 commits). Co-founded AvatarMEDIC as CEO/CTO; three hackathon and challenge wins; Founder Institute graduate. Runs workshops that leave teams with a system they can operate themselves.

xr.label: XR / Spatial Designer
xr.summary: XR product designer across Meta Quest, HoloLens 2 and visionOS. Lead XR Product Designer at Nanome (Spotlight/Follow collaboration, the non-rivalrous molecule, wrist UI); immersive UX at BadVR (AROC HUD, hand tracking, SeeSignal); XR robot control that won the Aerospace Medical Association's R&D Innovation Award. Speaker at AWE USA 2024, XRDC 2024 mentor, contributor to Spatial Design: Breaking the 2D Paradigm.

work.summary: Molecular design platform for pharma researchers in VR, desktop and web.

highlights.text: Led product design for Nanome 2 on Meta Quest along with the companion web portal and integration with the Nanome MARA AI assistant.

Ran around 24 alpha and beta test sessions with groups of scientists working at customer sites including Pfizer, Novartis and academic labs, three to four users per session. Coded the feedback qualitatively into bugs, how-might-we questions, feature evidence and usability patterns, and turned it into development cycles.

Replaced teleport navigation with Spotlight/Follow: labeled cursors and a shared, non-rivalrous molecule, so collaborators keep independent viewpoints while sharing focus. It became a pillar of Nanome 2.
Consolidated Nanome 1's feature set into a new interface layout and wrist-based UI, and designed the information architecture for projects inside the app.
Acted as product lead inside a PM, project manager and design triad: user interviews, the PRD template and tracking system, the internal knowledge base in Coda, and team-wide workshops.
Art directed look development and production.
Supervised the visionOS beta.
Prototyped an LLM pipeline (text-davinci-002 with Coda) to code user feedback into structured reports; not reliable enough for production, so the coding stayed manual.
Prototyped in Unity and C#, ShapesXR and Blender.

highlights.text: Founded the company and led product strategy, pitching, concept development and engineering direction; graduated Founder Institute San Francisco (2020).

Built the robot demo in Unity, the visual design, animatics and composite shots single-handedly, including a digital-twin prototype of a robotic medical assistant for nursing homes that won the Aerospace Medical Association's R&D Innovation Award (2022).

SAR 5G: lead designer and asset creator on a search-and-rescue coordination app for Magic Leap One and 5G; AT&T 5G Hackathon winner, Best VR/AR/MR solution (2019).
Took part in analog astronaut missions to gather data for the concept; pivoted the company to consultancy before stepping away.
